title: 第19章 无忧无虑的花样少年第20章 他笑着却满脸泪水
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
苏星河笑的前仰后合，好一会儿才平静下来，问道:
“那个仙家弟子，不会是千贺宗的吧？”
“就是上宗的，好像姓赵！”
“上宗？”苏星河疑惑。
“就是千贺宗啊！这你都不知道，你不会是新来的吧？”病秧子斜眼。
“算是吧，叫赵什么？”苏星河点头，继续追问。
“嗯......赵人剑！”病秧子思索了片刻，喊出了一个名字。
“赵淫贱？”苏星河诧异，这是多么霸气侧漏，不畏世俗的名字！
“什么淫贱！你才淫贱，人家是人剑，人剑合一，天下无敌的人剑！”病秧子伸手在胸前一阵比划，嘴上跟着发出‘呲呲呲’的剑招拟声。
“哦哦，好名字！”苏星河给出大拇指，同时心中暗想，回去一定要认识下这个‘淫贱’。
“好了，都告诉你了，该履行你的承诺了！”病秧子看着苏星河，总觉着眼前这个少年像个神棍，只是穿的这一身天青色长袍材质优良，发髻又挽的十分精致，看起来又不像泼皮无赖。
对他的承诺也没有抱太大的期望，如果此时他耍赖皮，也就不计较了，无所谓的事儿，能在这偷偷的多看她一会儿，就心满意足了。
“我知道你是吹牛！也无所谓，在这里看看就好，我已经很满足了！”少年灿烂一笑，苍白的脸上难得浮现一抹潮红。
苏星河似乎从他脸上看到一些不一样的东西，心中有些莫名的东西，好像被触动了一下。
“跟我来！”苏星河拍拍他的肩膀，站起身。
“喂，你来真的，不用了，你快回来！”
见苏星河朝练武场走去，病秧子有些慌，没想到这小子来真的。
“快过来！等着我去揪你出来啊！你个偷窥狂！我要把你的猥琐全部告诉二小姐！”苏星河回头威胁。
病秧子不情不愿的站起来，跟着苏星河，有些局促不安。
“见过仙师！”

何晨光看到苏星河过来，伸手示意大家停下来，赶忙上前客气行礼。
众人也好奇的看向这个，让总武头都要客气行礼的少年，却规规矩矩站着没动，只有那一身火红的穆婉清，小跑着过来。
“见过仙师！”穆婉清笑的甜美，脸带梨涡。
“叫我苏星河就行！”苏星河笑着回礼，没有摆仙师的架子。
“你是仙师？”病秧子没想到，跟自己一起头盔的这个猥琐家伙，竟然是山上仙师，他第一想法不是惊讶，而是觉着有点滑稽。
仙师就长这样平平无奇？
苏星河不知道在对方心里，他已经被看轻了，还正了正衣衫，严肃道：
“怎么？难道我不像仙师？”
“像，像！”病秧子边说，边撇嘴，就差把嫌弃写在脸上了，不过还是老老实实的行了一礼。
“武大伟，你怎么跟仙师混......结伴前来！”木婉清差点秃噜嘴。
“我们.......我们......”被叫做武大伟的病秧子少年，‘我们’了半天，也没好意思把一起蹲墙根儿的事实说出来。
“我在后面看你们练武，碰巧遇到！”苏星河替他打圆场。
“哦！”穆婉清若有所思的盯着二人看了片刻，似乎要看穿些什么，只是这俩人，一个眼神躲闪，头都快埋到脚底了，另一个始终保持着微笑，标准的皮笑肉不笑的那种。
“武大伟兄弟，托我来给二小姐带句话！”苏星河卖了个关子，没有直接说，而是看向武大伟。
“他不是就在这么！”穆婉清看向畏畏缩缩的武大伟，不明所以。
反倒是总武头何晨光作为过来人，一眼就看穿了少年人的心思，虽然看穿了，他却是忍不住摇头叹息。
两人身份云泥之差，只怕是空相思一场了。
“喂！你自己说还是我来说？”苏星河抬肘，撞了下武大伟。
武大伟一个趔趄，差点摔倒。
“大哥，我没用力，你想碰瓷儿啊！”苏星河连忙将其扶住。

“我......我......”武大伟我了半天，没有下文了。
“还是我来说吧！这小子喜欢你，不敢告诉你，天天躲在墙角偷偷看你！”苏星河月老上身，干起了牵线搭桥的买卖，报酬就是穆婉清她娘亲的大八卦。
content_en:
Su Xinghe laughed so hard that he calmed down after a while and asked:
"That disciple of the Immortal Family, isn't he from the Qianhe Sect?"
"He's from Shangzong, his surname seems to be Zhao!"
"Shangzong?" Su Xinghe was confused.
"It's the Qianhe Sect! You don't even know this. You're not new here, are you?" Bingyangzi squinted.
"That's right. What do you call Zhao?" Su Xinghe nodded and continued to ask.
"Well... Zhao Renjian!" Bingyangzi thought for a moment and called out a name.
"Zhao Xianjian?" Su Xinghe was surprised. What a domineering and unconventional name this is!
"What a slut! You are a slut, I am a human sword, the human sword is one, the human sword is invincible in the world!" The sick man stretched out his hand to make gestures in front of his chest, and made a sound of sword moves like "呲呲岲".
"Oh, what a good name!" Su Xinghe gave a thumbs up, and at the same time thought to himself, he must get to know this 'slut' when he goes back.
"Okay, I've told you, it's time to fulfill your promise!" Bingyangzi looked at Su Xinghe, always feeling that the young man in front of him looked like a magician, but the sky-blue robe he wore was made of fine material, and his bun was pulled up very delicately, so he didn't look like a rogue.
I don't have high expectations for his promise. If he is cheating at this time, I won't care. It doesn't matter. I can just watch her secretly for a while, and I will be satisfied.
"I know you're bragging! It doesn't matter, just take a look here. I'm already very satisfied!" The young man smiled brightly, with a rare flush appearing on his pale face.
Su Xinghe seemed to see something different on his face, and something inexplicable seemed to be touched in his heart.
"Follow me!" Su Xinghe patted his shoulder and stood up.
"Hey, you're serious, no need, come back quickly!"
Seeing Su Xinghe walking towards the martial arts training ground, Bingyangzi was a little panicked, but he didn't expect this kid to be serious.
"Come here quickly! Wait for me to catch you out! You peeping tom! I will tell the second lady all your indecent ways!" Su Xinghe turned around and threatened.
Bingyangzi stood up reluctantly and followed Su Xinghe, feeling a little embarrassed.
"I've seen the immortal master!"
When He Chenguang saw Su Xinghe approaching, he stretched out his hand to signal everyone to stop, and hurriedly stepped forward to salute politely.
Everyone also looked at the young man curiously, who even made the chief military officer salute politely, but he stood still and did not move. Only Mu Wanqing, dressed in fiery red, trotted over.
"I've met the immortal master!" Mu Wanqing smiled sweetly, with a pear-shaped face.
"Just call me Su Xinghe!" Su Xinghe returned the greeting with a smile, not pretending to be an immortal master.
"Are you an immortal master?" Bingyangzi did not expect that the wretched guy wearing a helmet with him turned out to be an immortal master on the mountain. His first thought was not that he was surprised, but that he found it a bit funny.
Does the Immortal Master look so ordinary?
Su Xinghe didn't know that in the other person's heart, he was already looked down upon. He straightened his clothes and said seriously:
"What? Don't I look like an immortal?"
"Like, like!" Bingyangzi said, curling his lips, and his disdain was almost written on his face, but he still bowed honestly.
"Wu Dawei, why are you hanging out with the immortal master...come together!" Mu Wanqing almost pouted.
"We...we..." The sickly young man named Wu Dawei said "we" for a long time, but he was too embarrassed to tell the truth about the fact that we were squatting on the wall together.
"I was watching you practice martial arts from behind, and we happened to meet you!" Su Xinghe smoothed things over for him.
"Oh!" Mu Wanqing stared at the two of them thoughtfully for a moment, as if she wanted to see through something, but of the two of them, one of them had an evasive look, his head almost buried to the bottom of his feet, while the other always kept a smile, a standard smile that was superficial but not smiling.
"Brother Wu Dawei, please ask me to bring a message to the second lady!" Su Xinghe gave it a try and did not say directly, but looked at Wu Dawei.
"Isn't he just like this!" Mu Wanqing looked at Wu Dawei who was cowering, not knowing why.
On the contrary, Chief Wutou He Chenguang, as someone who had come before him, could see through the young man's thoughts at a glance. Although he saw through it, he couldn't help but shake his head and sigh.
The difference in identities between the two of them is probably just an empty love affair.
"Hey! Do you say it yourself or should I do it?" Su Xinghe raised his elbow and bumped into Wu Dawei.
Wu Dawei staggered and almost fell.
"Brother, I didn't use any strength, you want to touch Porcelain!" Su Xinghe quickly supported him.
"I...I..." Wu Dawei hesitated for a long time, but there was nothing more to say.
"Let me tell you! This kid likes you, but he doesn't dare to tell you. He hides in the corner and secretly watches you every day!" Su Xinghe got up early and started a matchmaking business, and the reward was Mu Wanqing's mother's big gossip.
